_doc.max_fix_turns: fix loop turn budget (no test sandbox)
_doc.budget_warning_turns: turns before the end when a model with no edit yet is told to make one
_doc.no_edit_nudges: times a model that ends its turn without an edit is pushed back
_doc.max_cutoffs: responses cut off at the output limit in a row before the loop gives up
_doc.test_mode: offline evals with a test sandbox: 'existing_tests' runs the repo's existing tests near the changed file before and after the fix and regenerates the fix when it breaks tests that passed before; 'off' submits the first fix untested
_doc.test_max_attempts: fix attempts in test mode, the first included (each retry is a full new fix run with the failures shown)
_doc.test_max_files: existing test files run per fix, best-scoring first (module name, area and function in the test path; mentions of the changed function)
_doc.test_timeout_s: seconds allowed for one test run
_doc.test_pick: which attempt is submitted when every attempt still breaks tests: 'fewest_broken' or 'last'
